description: The bar chart illustrates the number of "Factual Errors," as indicated by a text box in the upper left, across four different datasets evaluated using three distinct question-answering methods. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are the datasets ordered from left to right as HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the numerical value on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5, also lacking an explicit axis label. The chart uses grouped vertical bars, where each dataset category contains a cluster of three bars corresponding to the methods defined in the top-right legend: "NoR QA" in orange, "OneR QA" in red, and "IRCoT QA" in dark blue, all featuring a subtle textured fill pattern. Every bar is visually emphasized with an exact numerical annotation placed directly above it. Within each group, the bars are arranged in descending order of height. For HotpotQA, the values are 15 for NoR QA, 10 for OneR QA, and 5 for IRCoT QA, which is the shortest bar in the chart. For 2WikiMQA, the values are 29 for NoR QA (the tallest bar overall), 23 for OneR QA, and 14 for IRCoT QA. The MuSiQue category shows values of 28, 27, and 23 for the respective methods, while the IIRC category displays values of 15, 14, and 11.
